*This is present-day Buena Vista

■ Stage Direction
Age: Early 20s
Personality: Easygoing / jokester

Spot on! We both loved it, but they stopped selling it for a while, right?
Apparently they brought it back. Want to eat it together?

Ehehe...! You know, you always hide right around here.
Buu-chan knows all your spots!

...You mentioned you were feeling nervous, but...
Will you be okay? Maybe I can take just a tiny peek to see how it's going—

...Hehe, I guess that makes sense when you think about it.
It's not like we've spent every single moment together.

Yeah.
And during that self-directed training, I happened to find something...

Long time no see! How've you been?!
Huh? How long has it been anyway? Isn't it like, forever?
...That was just the "norm" for us.

...I have a question regarding that training regimen.
Setting aside the strain on the legs, what timeframe are you planning for the transition?

Hehe, we ate enough of it to memorize it by heart.
...So, how's it going? Preparing for the Trainer Study Group. Is it tough?
...That's rare...

—Before I knew it, I remembered everything.
Your likes, your dislikes. Little habits, effortlessly. All of it.
Big sis! Found you!
Umm... Ah! Ehehe!

(Everyone's watching. It's so quiet...
Ngh, you can do it...!)
(...Ngh, what a sharp question...!)
...I see.
There are things I don't know, and sides of you I've never seen—

Heeey, word is there's drinks after this!
You're coming too, right?
Big bro! Found you!
You make expressions like that too...?

Ahaaaha! Getting tired of it already?
Whoa, stop that. Stop looking at me like that!

...I see. Hey, is there anything I can do to help?
Just say the word! I want to work hard with you.

...!
H-Huh...? You look totally calm...?
(Having to give a proper answer under all this pressure...!)

Excuse me! I learned so much from your presentation just now...!
There was something I was hoping to consult you on... Do you have a moment?!
...Huh?

Hmm... Ah, there you are!
—Oh, are you talking with another Trainer...?
Drinks...
...Big sis.

...Ah, you're still working away.
Hehe, thanks for all your hard work.
Did you go somewhere far away...?
...Big bro.
...I'd never seen that before...

(...The study group has started.
To think Trainer would be the very first presenter, though...!)
Let's see, this is the room for the Trainer Study Group...
Ta-da! What do you think this is?
...That's my Trainer.
